title: ModelListingEntry
description: One entry of GET /v1/models as CONSUMED by `helixllm --list-models`. This is a real contract, not a design sketch: cmd/helixllm/list_models.go decodes exactly these fields, and TestModelListingContractMatchesDecoder compares this document's field set against the decoder's JSON tags in both directions (a promised-but-absent field and an undocumented field are both findings).

id.description: The STABLE derived identifier (naming.Derive output, e.g. helixllm-anton-qwen2-5-coder-3b-instruct-q4_k_m-f6771589d190). Shown in the command's third column so a copy-paste into configuration uses the value whose stability FR-015 relies on.

model_identity.description: The helixllm/<host>/<model>[:<variant>] identity. brain.ModelOption.DisplayName reads the clean name from it, so a listing shows `qwen2-5-coder-3b-instruct:q4_k_m` rather than the digest. Absent for remote (non-HelixLLM) options.

owned_by.description: The serving backend, e.g. llamacpp or a vendor name.

withheld_reason.description: Present when the option is withheld. Rendered as a trailing `(withheld: <reason>)` so 'withheld right now' stays distinguishable from 'does not exist' (FR-019).
